typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	sPrevBusDay as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		CLIENT as decimal(38,0),
		BR_ACCT as string,
		BR_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		TRADER as string,
		BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM as string,
		INVENTORY_CATEGORY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource1
OLEDBSource1 derive(EffectiveDate = toDate(toString($sPrevBusDay, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"),
		EFFDATE = toDate(toString($sPrevBusDay, 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy")) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of CLIENT_NBR} = CLIENT_NBR,
		{Copy of trader} = TRADER,
		{Copy of Client} = CLIENT,
		{Copy of INVENTORY_CATEGORY} = INVENTORY_CATEGORY,
		{Copy of BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM} = BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM,
		{Copy of br_acct} = BR_ACCT,
		{Copy of BR_ACCOUNT_CD} = BR_ACCOUNT_CD) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		br_acct as string,
		br_account_cd as string,
		Client_Nbr as string,
		br_account_short_nm as string,
		trader as string,
		inventory_category as string,
		EffDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Client as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		br_acct = {Copy of br_acct},
		br_account_cd = {Copy of BR_ACCOUNT_CD},
		Client_Nbr = {Copy of CLIENT_NBR},
		br_account_short_nm = {Copy of BR_ACCOUNT_SHORT_NM},
		trader = {Copy of trader},
		inventory_category = {Copy of INVENTORY_CATEGORY},
		EffDATE = EffectiveDate,
		Client = {Copy of Client}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
